answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Like an opal set in basalt, an agent’s identity is anchored by its economic stake, forming a dense grove of value-backed nodes. To influence the consensus, an attacker must acquire a majority share of the total staked supply, ensuring that the cost of a Sybil attack is directly proportional to the network’s cumulative financial weight.
